caption: The drawing features a rectangular section of fabric with a vertical, decorative column positioned slightly left of center. The column is ornate, displaying a geometric, repeating pattern in shades of brown, red, and gold, with leaf motifs at the top and a basketweave texture in the central section. Surrounding and partially overlapping the column are large, blooming flowers in shades of pink with darker red outlines and yellow-white centers. The flowers are accompanied by broad, green leaves with detailed veining, and smaller buds. The background is filled with clusters of smaller flowers and leaves in pink, blue, and muted green, all set against a beige, lightly textured backdrop. The overall color palette is composed of earth tones with prominent use of pink, red, green, brown, gold, and beige. The fabric section appears to be centered on a larger piece of plain, off-white paper, and a handwritten name, "A.J. Perkins," is visible in small letters near the bottom left corner.
title: Printed Textile
